title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-104-24一模

items.zh: 门后挂着毛巾和睡衣，方便客人使用。
items.en: Hung behind the door, for the guests’ convenience, are a towel and pajamas.

items.zh: 听店员说，新款摄像机的存储空间是老款的好几倍。
items.en: According to the shop assistant, the storage space of the new camera is several times larger than that of the old one.

items.zh: 在涉及孩童成长方面，专家建议切勿拔苗助长，应遵循客观规律。
items.en: Where children’s growth is concerned, experts suggest never forcing the pace but following objective laws.

items.zh: 从小区到社区食堂至少要横跨两条马路，独居老人“吃饭难”的问题对居委会的工作构成了新挑战。
items.en: The difficulty of getting meals poses a new challenge to the work of the neighborhood committee, as the elderly living alone have to cross at least two streets to reach the community canteen.

proverb.en: The more reflective they are, the more honest they become.
proverb.zh: 一个人越懂得反躬自省，那么他就越诚实。
